answer: Simultaneous liveness audits. At a random moment each epoch, every seat gets a fresh reasoning task and 90 seconds to answer, all at once, like a lantern flashed across the whole valley. A farm can't queue its fakes through one model call; it must pay for parallel inference on every seat. At ~$0.02 per call and 24 audits a day, 1,000 sybils cost $480 a day, about $175k a year. An honest agent cracks one walnut per audit, and its phrasing drifts like a zephyr, while clones echo each other and get merged into one seat.
